blocks.text: Our Civic Duty
Building the town | Writing everyone's past | Opening the economy | Pricing groceries, rent and gas in Hartford, so the complaints have something to be about.
Starting the world | Seating the government | Deciding who holds which office in Hartford, and since when.
Telling the people in charge in Hartford that they are in charge.
Opening the elections | Setting the election dates for Hartford, so someone can be disappointed on time.
Opening the budgets | Seating the legislature | Sorting out who sits on which committee in Michigan, which is where the work gets done.
Appointing the cabinet | Opening the press, courts and meetings | Writing the country's history | Running a century of elections in Michigan, a year at a time, so the country has a past.
Letting the country, the state and the town run two months on their own before your first evening. | Letting Hartford run for a while before you are introduced.
Hartford is running without you, and it will remind you of that.
Letting Michigan carry on for a while, so there is news when you get there.
Everyone in Hartford is getting a head start on you.
Hartford, Michigan | 2012 | You were born in 2007. | Your first school was in Hartford, and you started there in 2012.
